name: Silk Road Fund Co., Ltd. (丝路基金有限公司)
via: Russia's Federal Antimonopoly Service called the SIBUR-buying entity 'the Silk Road Fund subsidiary, controlled by the People's Republic of China' (TASS, 2017-01-11)
note: Chinese state investment fund financing Belt and Road projects; set up on President Xi Jinping's announcement with state capital (the fund's own site). Holds 8.5% of SIBUR Holding (Interfax, 2024-11-05).
